record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, switch the existing two bidirectional Transformer blocks from pre-norm to post-norm by setting norm_first=False, retaining the final LayerNorm. Conventional BERT-style residual normalization may improve masked-item representations under full-catalog cross-entropy. Keep embeddings, widths, heads, features, sampling, readout, loss and optimizer fixed. Preserve exclusive-mask training and appended-mask inference; use the same architecture in the predictor writer.
